title: Network Terms and Out-of-Network Reimbursement Shares
content:
Network contracting terms applying to the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders.

## 1. The terms by rider

| Rider | Out-of-network share of the allowed amount (per cent) | Providers in the rider's network | A network provider may bill the member above the allowed amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 0 | 4800 | no |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 60 | 9600 | no |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 50 | 2100 | no |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 60 | 4800 | no |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 70 | 5400 | no |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 70 | 9600 | no |

## 2. The terms defined

2.1 The out-of-network share is the share of the allowed amount the rider pays at a provider outside the network, stated as a percentage.

2.2 The provider count is the number of dental, vision and hearing providers in the rider's network.

2.3 The final column states whether a network provider may bill the member above the allowed amount. Balance billing protection is carried on every rider in this schedule, and on each of them the answer is no.

## 3. Notes on the schedule

3.1 The Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider carries an out-of-network share of 0, the only rider in the schedule to do so. The remaining five carry a share above nil: 50 on the Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider, 60 on the Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider and the Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider, and 70 on the Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider.

3.2 Network size does not move with the out-of-network share. The largest networks in the schedule, at 9600 providers, belong to the Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider, which carry 60 and 70 respectively; the smallest, at 2100 providers, belongs to the Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider.
